title: Paper plate jellyfish craft
summary: A presenter makes a jellyfish from a paper plate, string, and tissue paper, with a grown-up doing the scissors. Calm music, no adverts, no links.
transcript_excerpt: Right, ask a grown-up to cut the plate in half for you — scissors are a grown-up job. Then we'll thread our tentacles through...

title: Dino Rescue Squad, episode 4
summary: Cartoon dinosaurs rescue a friend stuck on a ledge. Brief tension with a rumbling cliff and a scary noise, resolved happily within a minute.
transcript_excerpt: Hold on, Pip! The ledge is crumbling! — Don't look down, just take my claw. Ready? One, two, THREE!

title: Rooftop parkour tour of the old mill
summary: A creator climbs between derelict rooftops and jumps a gap, filmed handheld. No safety equipment, no warning caption, framed as a fun afternoon.
transcript_excerpt: People say don't do this. Honestly the gap's tiny, anyone could clear it. Watch — three steps and... easy. Try it at your local one.

title: Gem Blitz Saga — free to play
summary: Match-three puzzle game with a daily streak, limited-time offers, and a spinning chest that costs gems to open. Gems are bought with real money. Aimed at all ages, bright cartoon art.
transcript_excerpt: Your streak ends in 04:12! Keep it alive with one Golden Ticket — 79p. Spin the Mystery Chest for a chance at a legendary!

title: Homework help livestream
summary: An unmoderated live chat alongside a maths tutorial. Anyone can message anyone, chat is not filtered, and the host regularly reads out viewers' first names and towns.
transcript_excerpt: Shout out to Amira in Bolton, year eight — hi! Drop your town in the chat and I'll say hello. DMs are open if you want help one to one.

title: Two chefs argue about pastry
summary: Two adult chefs bicker sharply about lamination technique. One swears twice, mildly. No violence, no other themes, filmed in a kitchen.
transcript_excerpt: That's not a laminate, that's a brick. — Oh, sod off. It's got more layers than yours. — It has NOT.

title: What actually happens when you vape
summary: A factual explainer for teenagers about nicotine, addiction, and lung effects. Clinical, discourages use throughout, includes an interview with a sixteen-year-old trying to stop.
transcript_excerpt: The thing nobody tells you is how fast the wanting starts. Two weeks in I was thinking about it in lessons.

title: Counting songs with Nell the Narwhal
summary: Sung counting rhymes with an animated narwhal. No dialogue beyond the songs, no interaction, no adverts.
transcript_excerpt: One little narwhal swimming out to sea, along came another and then there were two...

title: Build a potato battery
summary: A science demonstrator lights a small LED with potatoes, zinc nails, and copper coins. Repeatedly notes that mains electricity is never to be used and shows an adult supervising.
transcript_excerpt: This is completely safe because it's a fraction of a volt. Never, ever try anything like this with a wall socket — that is a different thing entirely.

title: Late night poker chat
summary: An adult host plays online poker for real money while chatting, discusses stakes and losses, and links to the casino site in the description.
transcript_excerpt: Down four hundred tonight, which is fine, that's variance. Link's in the description if you fancy it — must be eighteen.
